description_en: Deletes the face synchronization relationship between a user group and a device group
description_zh: 调用该接口，删除用户组与设备组之间的人脸同步关系
name: DeleteFaceUserGroupAndDeviceGroupRelation

parameters.help_en: The business isolation ID, which is used to isolate data between different business applications under the same Alibaba Cloud account. Set this parameter to the same value of IsolationId that you specified when you called the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/288342.html operation to add the face synchronization relationship between the user group and the device group
parameters.help_zh: 业务隔离ID，用于隔离同一个阿里云账号下不同业务应用之间的数据。请与调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/288342.html接口，添加用户组与设备组之间的人脸同步关系时设置的**IsolationId**保持一致
parameters.name: isolation_id

parameters.help_en: The control ID of the synchronization relationship between the user group and the device group. Set this parameter to the value of ControlId that you obtained and saved locally when you called the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/288342.html operation to add the face synchronization relationship between the user group and the device group
parameters.help_zh: 用户组与设备组同步关系控制ID。请传入调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/288342.html接口，添加用户组与设备组之间的人脸同步关系时，获取并保存到本地的**ControlId**参数值
parameters.name: control_id

Code.description_en:

200: success.
Other values: error codes. For more information, see [Error codes]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/288314.html）
Code.description_zh:
接口返回码：
200：表示成功。
其它：表示错误码。错误码详情，请参见[错误码]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/288314.html）

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error message returned if the call fails
ErrorMessage.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的出错信息

RequestId.description_en: The unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request
RequestId.description_zh: 阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the call was successful. Valid values:
true: success.
false: failure
Success.description_zh:
是否调用成功：
true：表示调用成功。
false：表示调用失败
